sources.snippet: Treat model: "mesh" as a preview feature rather than a stable production path; use a specific model id when you need stable semantics. Send a request with "model": "mesh" and the proxy fans it out to every model available in the mesh in parallel, arbitrates their responses with deterministic logic, and returns one OpenAI-compatible reply.
